title: sos_signature.json: wrong-key vector kept stale claimed_pubkey placeholder
description: 3x codereview on b7z9.121.5 (all 3 passes converged): test/vectors/sos_signature.json sos_wrong_key_signature_drop pinned real key material but kept claimed_pubkey 'wrong_pubkey_not_matching_iid' (non-hex placeholder) alongside the real pubkey — hex-parse hazard and conceptually wrong (rejection is IID-binding, not wrong pubkey).
